_: GutLog v3.22.0 -- meal cards. v3.21.0 has no card, no endpoints and no meal_meta, so every assertion fails there by version.
Two boundaries are also broken on purpose in the current build: the egg count carried into the chosen style, and Edit keeping the time the meal was logged.

assertions.name: 01 the cards come from the meal file, with what the library lacks
02 one tap logs the card as it stands
03 choices, counts in halves, and 'last time' remembered
04 the onion switch and a deselected choice
05 a missing food never breaks a log
06 Edit keeps the original time and rewrites the meal
07 Again logs the same meal now
09 a dish never seen before, by name only
10 search puts what was eaten recently first
11 the Now tab carries the meal card
12 in a real browser: one tap, and a new dish
